title: Classifying Matter物质的分类

slides.h:
🧩 Classifying Matter物质的分类

Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子

OX2​, COX2​, NaCl, Fe, SOX4​X2− — the test gives you a list of formulas and asks: atom, element, molecule, compound or ion? Some get two labels. Four quick questions sort every one.OX2​、COX2​、NaCl、Fe、SOX4​X2−——考试给一串化学式，问：原子、元素、分子、化合物还是离子？有的要写两个标签。四个小问题就能全部分清。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子
  1. Charge → ion. Lone symbol / "one particle" → atom.有电荷→离子。单个符号／「一个粒子」→原子。
  2. 2+ atoms, one type → molecule + element (OX2​). 2+ types → molecule + compound (HX2​O).2 个以上原子、一种→分子＋元素（OX2​）。两种以上→分子＋化合物（HX2​O）。
  3. Element = one TYPE of atom, not one atom. Class key: NaCl → compound only.元素＝一「种」原子，不是一个原子。讲义答案：NaCl 只是化合物。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子
  • Which label?贴哪个标签？
    • Charge shown (+ / −)有电荷（＋／－）
      • Ion (I)离子（I）NO3−, SO4 2−NO3−、SO4 2−
    • One particle / single symbol一个粒子／单个符号
      • Atom (A)原子（A）Fe, Cl, one copper particleFe、Cl、一个铜粒子
    • 2+ atoms, one type2 个以上原子，同一种
      • Molecule + Element (M, E)分子＋元素（M、E）O2, F2O2、F2
    • 2+ atoms, different types2 个以上原子，不同种
      • Molecule + Compound (M, C)分子＋化合物（M、C）H2O, CO2, NH3, CH4H2O、CO2、NH3、CH4
      • NaCl → Compound (C) onlyNaCl → 只标化合物（C）

🧗 The hard part难点 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子

Giving one or two labels贴一个还是两个标签

The same formula can be a molecule AND an element/compound, and students stop after one.同一个化学式可以既是分子又是元素／化合物，学生常写一个就停。

  1. Charged? → I only.带电？→只写 I。
  2. Single symbol? → A only.单个符号？→只写 A。
  3. Bonded atoms? → M, then add E (one type) or C (different types). NaCl-type → C.原子成键？→写 M，再加 E（一种）或 C（不同种）。NaCl 类→C。
Try试一试
Label CHX4​, FX2​, Cl.标注 CHX4​、FX2​、Cl。
Answer答案
CHX4​: M, C · FX2​: E, M · Cl: ACHX4​：M、C · FX2​：E、M · Cl：A

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Atom, element, molecule, compound, ion原子、元素、分子、化合物、离子
  • OX2​ has 2 atoms so not an element → one type = element (and molecule).OX2​ 有 2 个原子所以不是元素 → 一种原子＝元素（也是分子）。
  • SOX4​X2− is a compound → the charge makes it an ion.SOX4​X2− 是化合物 → 有电荷，是离子。
🟡
Your class answer key labels a lone symbol like Fe or Cl as an atom, labels O2 and F2 as both molecule and element, and labels NaCl as a compound only. Many textbooks would say Fe can also mean the element iron, and that NaCl is an ionic compound made of ions, not molecules — which is why NaCl gets only "C" even though the class notes box says "all compounds are molecules". On this test use the class labels.课堂答案把 Fe、Cl 这样的单个符号标为原子，把 O2、F2 标为分子兼元素，把 NaCl 只标为化合物。很多教材会说 Fe 也可以指铁这种元素，而 NaCl 是由离子构成的离子化合物、不是分子——这也是为什么讲义方框写着「所有化合物都是分子」，NaCl 却只标「C」。考试按讲义的标签答。
🎯
Ask in order: charge? one particle? how many types?依次问：有电荷？单个粒子？几种原子？

🧩 Classifying Matter物质的分类

Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液

Salt water, trail mix, copper, sugar, air — every one lands in exactly one box of the classification tree. Learn the two questions that walk you down the tree and this whole section is marks.盐水、什锦坚果、铜、糖、空气——每一样都正好落在分类树的一个格子里。学会沿着树往下走的两个问题，这一整节就是送分。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液
  1. Homogeneous = 1 phase; heterogeneous = more than 1 phase = mechanical mixture.均匀＝1 个相；不均匀＝不止 1 个相＝机械混合物。
  2. Homogeneous splits: pure substance (constant composition) vs solution (variable composition).均匀物质再分：纯净物（组成固定）与溶液（组成可变）。
  3. Pure splits: element (1 type of atom) vs compound (more than 1). Solute dissolves in solvent.纯净物再分：元素（1 种原子）与化合物（不止 1 种）。溶质溶于溶剂。

🖼️ Picture it看图理解 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液
  • ALL SUBSTANCES所有物质
    • HOMOGENEOUS SUBSTANCES均匀物质only one phase只有一个相
      • PURE SUBSTANCES纯净物constant composition组成固定
        • ELEMENT元素（单质）1 type of atom present只有 1 种原子
        • COMPOUND化合物more than 1 type of atom present不止 1 种原子
      • HOMOGENEOUS MIXTURES均匀混合物variable composition组成可变
        • SOLUTION溶液
    • HETEROGENEOUS SUBSTANCES不均匀物质more than one phase不止一个相
      • MECHANICAL MIXTURES机械混合物variable composition组成可变

🧗 The hard part难点 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液

Pure substance vs solution纯净物与溶液

Both are one phase and look identical.两者都是一个相，看起来一模一样。

  1. Does it have one fixed formula? → pure.有单一固定化学式吗？→纯净物。
  2. Can the amounts change (more or less salty/sweet)? → solution.比例能变吗（更咸／更甜）？→溶液。
  3. Evidence: evaporating a solution leaves the solute behind.证据：溶液蒸干后会留下溶质。
Try试一试
Pure substance or solution: (a) apple juice (b) HX2​OX2​ (pure hydrogen peroxide)纯净物还是溶液：(a) 苹果汁 (b) HX2​OX2​（纯过氧化氢）
Answer答案
(a) solution (b) pure substance (compound)(a) 溶液 (b) 纯净物（化合物）

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Pure substances, mixtures, solutions纯净物、混合物与溶液
  • Clear liquid = pure → could be a solution (salt water).澄清液体＝纯净物 → 也可能是溶液（盐水）。
  • Compound = mixture (has 2 elements) → compound is pure (fixed formula).化合物＝混合物（含两种元素）→ 化合物是纯净物（化学式固定）。
🟡
Your class notes list soil as a homogeneous mixture. Most textbooks call soil heterogeneous (a mechanical mixture), because you can usually see bits of sand, clay and plant matter. On this test, if soil is asked, use the class answer: homogeneous mixture.课堂讲义把土壤列为均匀混合物。多数教材把土壤归为不均匀混合物（机械混合物），因为通常能看到沙粒、黏土和植物残渣。考试如果问到土壤，按讲义答：均匀混合物。
🎯
Three questions in order: phases? fixed composition? types of atom?按顺序三问：几个相？组成固定？几种原子？

cards.f: Element?元素？
cards.b: Pure substance of only ONE TYPE of atom (not one atom). OX2​, Cu.只由一「种」原子构成的纯净物（不是一个原子）。OX2​、Cu。

cards.f: Molecule vs compound?分子与化合物的区别？
cards.b: Molecule: 2+ atoms bonded, same or different. Compound: 2+ DIFFERENT types chemically combined.分子：2 个以上原子成键，同种或不同种。化合物：2 种以上「不同」原子化学结合。

cards.f: How do you spot an ion?怎么认出离子？
cards.b: A charge in the formula: NOX3​X−, SOX4​X2−.化学式上有电荷：NOX3​X−、SOX4​X2−。

cards.f: Atom?原子？
cards.b: Smallest particle of an element with its properties; made of protons, neutrons, electrons.保持元素性质的最小粒子；由质子、中子、电子构成。

cards.f: Class labels for OX2​, CHX4​, NaCl?讲义中 OX2​、CHX4​、NaCl 的标签？
cards.b: OX2​: M, E. CHX4​: M, C. NaCl: C.OX2​：M、E。CHX4​：M、C。NaCl：C。

cards.f: Homogeneous vs heterogeneous?均匀与不均匀？
cards.b: Homogeneous: one phase, looks the same. Heterogeneous: more than one phase.均匀：一个相，处处相同。不均匀：不止一个相。

cards.f: Pure substance vs homogeneous mixture?纯净物与均匀混合物？
cards.b: Pure: constant composition, one substance. Homogeneous mixture: variable composition, 2+ substances.纯净物：组成固定、一种物质。均匀混合物：组成可变、2 种以上物质。

cards.f: Another name for a homogeneous mixture? For a heterogeneous mixture?均匀混合物的另一个名称？不均匀混合物呢？
cards.b: Solution. Mechanical mixture.溶液。机械混合物。

cards.f: Solute vs solvent in salt water?盐水中的溶质和溶剂？
cards.b: Solute: salt (gets dissolved). Solvent: water (does the dissolving).溶质：盐（被溶解）。溶剂：水（起溶解作用）。

cards.f: Class answer: soil is…?讲义答案：土壤是……？
cards.b: A homogeneous mixture (class version; many textbooks say heterogeneous).均匀混合物（讲义说法；很多教材说不均匀）。

cards.f: Element vs compound on the tree?分类树上元素与化合物？
cards.b: Both pure substances. Element: 1 type of atom. Compound: more than 1 type.都是纯净物。元素：1 种原子。化合物：不止 1 种原子。

quiz.q: Which labels fit COX2​?COX2​ 应贴哪些标签？
opts: Element and molecule元素和分子
Compound only, because it has 3 atoms只是化合物，因为有 3 个原子
Ion离子
Molecule and compound分子和化合物
quiz.hint: Bonded → M; different types → C.成键→M；不同种→C。
quiz.why: Correct: bonded atoms of two different types → M, C.正确：两种不同原子成键→M、C。
whys: Element needs one type of atom; COX2​ has two (C and O).元素只能有一种原子；COX2​ 有两种（C 和 O）。
Forgets that bonded atoms also make it a molecule; the class key gives two labels.忘了原子成键也使它成为分子；讲义答案是两个标签。
No charge is shown, so it is not an ion.没有电荷，不是离子。
Correct: bonded atoms of two different types → M, C.正确：两种不同原子成键→M、C。

quiz.q: A sample of pure copper wire contains billions of copper atoms. What is the wire?一段纯铜线含有数十亿个铜原子。这段铜线是什么？
opts: A compound, because it has many atoms化合物，因为原子很多
An element, because there is only one type of atom元素，因为只有一种原子
An ion, because metals have charges离子，因为金属带电荷
Not an element, because an element is one atom不是元素，因为元素只有一个原子
quiz.hint: Like the 10 g gold piece in the notes.同讲义里 10 g 金块的例子。
quiz.why: Correct: one TYPE of atom (copper) → element, no matter how many atoms.正确：只有一「种」原子（铜）→元素，不管有多少个。
whys: Compounds need different types of atom; the number of atoms does not matter.化合物需要不同种原子；原子多少无关。
Correct: one TYPE of atom (copper) → element, no matter how many atoms.正确：只有一「种」原子（铜）→元素，不管有多少个。
A copper wire carries no overall charge; no + or − is shown.铜线整体不带电，也没有标出 ＋ 或 －。
Classic mix-up: one type of atom does not mean one atom.经典误区：一种原子不等于一个原子。

quiz.q: Trail mix (nuts, raisins, chocolate) is a:什锦坚果（坚果、葡萄干、巧克力）是：
opts: Solution溶液
Compound化合物
Mechanical mixture机械混合物
Pure substance纯净物
quiz.hint: Visible parts → more than one phase.看得见不同部分→不止一个相。
quiz.why: Correct: visible different parts → heterogeneous → mechanical mixture.正确：看得见不同部分→不均匀→机械混合物。
whys: A solution looks the same everywhere; you can see separate pieces here.溶液处处一样；这里能看到分开的块。
A compound is a pure substance with a fixed formula; trail mix has none.化合物是有固定化学式的纯净物；什锦坚果没有。
Correct: visible different parts → heterogeneous → mechanical mixture.正确：看得见不同部分→不均匀→机械混合物。
Many substances in variable amounts — not pure.含多种比例不定的物质——不是纯净物。

quiz.q: Air is a mixture of nitrogen, oxygen and other gases, yet it looks the same everywhere. Where does air go on the tree?空气是氮气、氧气和其他气体的混合物，但处处看起来一样。空气在分类树的哪里？
opts: Pure substance, because it is uniform纯净物，因为它均匀
Solution (homogeneous mixture)溶液（均匀混合物）
Mechanical mixture, because it has several gases机械混合物，因为含多种气体
Element, because it is a gas元素，因为它是气体
quiz.hint: One phase AND more than one substance → solution.一个相且不止一种物质→溶液。
quiz.why: Correct: one phase + several substances in variable amounts → solution.正确：一个相＋多种比例可变的物质→溶液。
whys: Uniform only means homogeneous; air has several substances, so it is not pure.均匀只说明是均匀物质；空气含多种物质，不是纯净物。
Correct: one phase + several substances in variable amounts → solution.正确：一个相＋多种比例可变的物质→溶液。
Several substances does not mean heterogeneous — gases mix into one phase.多种物质不等于不均匀——气体会混成一个相。
Being a gas says nothing about the types of atom; air has several elements and compounds.是气体与原子种类无关；空气含多种元素和化合物。
